properties.description: common pre-reaction complex of cyclopentadiene + acrylonitrile (1:1 van der Waals/pi-stacked dimer), the lowest verified minimum of this complex found in the evidence (three connected conformer minima were located: -364.698789158, -364.698325728, -364.698081670 Ha, all within 0.45 kcal/mol). Minimum, no imaginary frequency; shared barrier reference for both stereochemical channels.

endo concerted transition state; nitrile carbon C8 tucked under the diene pi system (C8...C5 = 3.02 A, C8...C1 = 3.54 A) and remote from the forming one-carbon bridge (C8...C3 = 3.80 A); forming bonds C2-C6 = 2.38 A, C4-C7 = 2.73 A; exactly one imaginary frequency, -457.50 cm-1 (concerted forming mode). IRC in ts/ts_0002/jobs/declaration_0003/irc/irc.log.

exo concerted transition state; nitrile rotated outward towards the future one-carbon bridge (C8...C3 = 3.08 A) and away from the diene pi system (C8...C1 = 4.28 A); forming bonds C2-C6 = 2.10 A, C4-C7 = 2.39 A; exactly one imaginary frequency, -456.61 cm-1 (pair projections C2-C6 = 0.996, C4-C7 = 0.771). IRC in ts/ts_0001/jobs/declaration_0003/irc/irc.log.

endo-2-cyanobicyclo[2.2.1]hept-5-ene: nitrile cis to the norbornene C=C (C8...C5 = 3.00 A) and anti to the one-carbon bridge (C8...C3 = 3.78 A); minimum, lowest frequency 107.27 cm-1, no imaginary frequency.

exo-2-cyanobicyclo[2.2.1]hept-5-ene: nitrile cis to the one-carbon bridge (C8...C3 = 3.09 A) and anti to the norbornene C=C (C8...C1 = 4.23 A); minimum, lowest frequency 108.00 cm-1, no imaginary frequency.
